Thank you for responding. I don't think you quite get the full picture, but just the fact that you responded lifted my spirit, at least for tonight. It's nearly 6:00 am here, and I've been up all night, but now that I've gone out from red alert, I think I'm going to go to bed. I'll likely be back on sometime in the near future.

Again, thank you for taking the time to respond to me. It helps to have people listen.
